svg.title: Rain gardens & swales · Rain garden
svg.desc: Rain garden filters runoff through planted medium, with infiltration where suitable and drainage or overflow. A swale conveys runoff and provides temporary storage. Source claims: rain-gardens. Conceptual cutaways use diagram coordinates, not metre construction dimensions. Profiles, layer proportions, process arrow positions and vegetation arrangements are assistant illustration choices. No layer depths, capacities, tank sizes, rates or wet loads are derived from this geometry. Dashed infiltration is conditional on soil and groundwater; arrow lengths do not indicate rates. The separate source slope triangle alone is metric.
